# Arigato Travel

> > Japan's premier culinary and cultural tourism company offering guided food tours, cherry blossom experiences, and travel consulting across Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka, and beyond.

Arigato Travel specializes in authentic Japanese experiences through food tours, seasonal hanami walks, and cultural immersion. The company also provides corporate event services, tourism consulting, and personalized travel planning with local expert guides throughout Japan.

## Key Topics

- Japanese cuisine and culinary tourism
- Cherry blossom (sakura) season and hanami traditions
- Tokyo, Kyoto, and Osaka guided experiences
- Japanese cultural heritage and traditions
- Seasonal travel in Japan
- Corporate events and team building
- Local expert tour guides
- Mt. Fuji and regional destinations
- Ichigo ichie (once-in-a-lifetime moments)
- Winter travel and seasonal foods
- Japanese festivals and celebrations
- Hiroshima and regional tourism
- Travel consulting and planning services
- Family-friendly Japan travel

## Core Services

- [Arigato Travel | Culinary and Cultural Experiences in Japan](https://arigatotravel.com): Homepage for Japan's #1 culinary tourism company offering food & cultural tours
- [2026 Cherry Blossom Tours | Arigato Travel](https://arigatotravel.com/special-tours/sakura-tours): 2026 hanami walking tours in Tokyo Yanaka & Osaka Karahori neighborhoods
- [Personal Travel Consulting](https://arigatotravel.com/services/personal-travel-consulting-package): Expert Japan travel planning & restaurant reservation service via Zoom
- [Corporate Events, Team Building Tourism](https://arigatotravel.com/services/corporate-events-team-building-tourism): Corporate team building & event services in Tokyo, Kyoto, Osaka by Arigato
- [Inbound and International Tourism Consulting](https://arigatotravel.com/services/inbound-and-international-tourism-consulting): Tourism consulting for Japan destinations: marketing, training & FAM tours

## Seasonal Travel Guides

- [Things to Do in Kyoto in February 2026](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/things-to-do-kyoto-february-2026): Kyoto February 2026 events: Setsubun at Yasaka Shrine & winter festivals
- [Things to Do in Tokyo in March 2026](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/things-to-do-tokyo-march-2026): Tokyo March 2026 events: Hinamatsuri, Art Fair Tokyo & spring festivals
- [ONE-DAY PERFECT PLAN: ENJOYING HANAMI IN KYOTO](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/one-day-itinerary-hanami-kyoto): One-day Kyoto cherry blossom itinerary: Philosopher's Path & Nanzen-ji
- [Traveling with Kids in Japan During Wintertime](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/traveling-with-kids-japan-wintertime): Family winter travel guide covering Hokkaido, Tokyo, Kyoto snow activities
- [From Bud to Blossom: March Affirmations of Presence and Hope](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/bud-to-blossom-march-affirmations): March mindfulness guide exploring ichigo ichie & cherry blossom season in Japan

## Japanese Cuisine & Dining Culture

- [Top Winter Foods to Keep You Warm](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/top-winter-foods-keep-you-warm): Guide to Japanese winter comfort foods: nabe, sukiyaki, oden & ochazuke
- [Otoshi: All About Japan's Unusual Appetisers](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/otoshi-japans-appetisers): Explains otoshi table charge custom & appetizers in Japanese restaurants

## Cultural Heritage & Traditions

- [All About Aizome: History, Roots, What it is, Patterns, and What they Symbolize](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/all-about-aizome-history-roots-what-it-is-patterns-and-what-they-symbolize): Deep dive into Aizome indigo dyeing history from China to Japanese tradition
- [National Foundation Day in Japan: Celebrating the Origins of a Nation](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/national-foundation-day): Explains Kenkoku Kinen no Hi (Feb 11) & Emperor Jimmu founding mythology
- [The Soundtracks of Japan: Exploring Catchy Jingles](https://arigatotravel.com/blog/soundtrack-of-japan-jingles): Guide to iconic Japanese store jingles from Don Quijote & FamilyMart

## Regional Destinations
